source.title: Bioelectric signaling regulates head and organ size during planarian regeneration.
source.location: Fig. 2A and Results section 'H,K-ATPase inhibition blocks membrane depolarization and pharyngeal scaling' (paragraph beginning 'RNA interference (RNAi) of the Smed-H,K-ATPase')

stage: pharynx fragment (trunk fragment containing original pharynx)
injury: amputation just anterior and just posterior to the pharynx

intervention.timing: dsRNA injected on days 1-3; animals cut on day 8 or 14 (as stated)
intervention.duration: dsRNA injections on days 1-3; regenerates scored at 14 dpa
intervention.description: Worms injected with dsRNA targeting Smed-H,K-ATPase, then pharynx fragments amputated and allowed to regenerate for 14 days.

readout.method: brightfield morphological scoring of regenerate head and pharynx size and placement

notes: Paper gives percentages only: 4.2% headless (text) and 91.6% shrunken-head phenotype (figure legend). Numbers are percentages, not animal counts, and are NOT summed to 100 because the remaining ~4.2% of regenerates are not described. n is stated only as n>=125 (lower bound, not exact), so n_total is null. 'other' = shrunken head: anterior head reduced to roughly half of control size, with an oversized pharynx placed anteriorly and tiny brain/head tissue confined to new tissue. Counts are percentages in the count field. Continuous size and marker measures in the same arm were not converted to counts.
